# Beta
> The page sitting at exactly the two-hop limit.

## What it is
A concept page reachable only through [[alpha]], which puts it two hops from
[[INDEX]] — the furthest `wiki/SCHEMA.md` rule 2 allows, and therefore legal.

## How we use it (project-specific!)
As the boundary case for the index-drift check: two hops must pass, so a check
that reports this page is off by one. It is also the only page linking
[[gamma]], which is what pushes gamma over the limit.
